footer_text: Thank you for being a part of my life. There's nobody I've ever wanted a future with more than you, and there's nobody I'm more grateful to know. I feel so lucky to have met someone like you; someone who matches me on so many levels, is compatible with me socially, in hobbies, in humor, in mannerisms, in life goals- hell, even in attraction. I know we've had hard times, but those times are also complimented by the highs I feel every day while being with you. I strive every day to be a better partner for you, someone you want to be with. Nothing in this world matters more to me than your happiness. I'm looking forward to a future where I can brighten your days as often as possible. I love you, perfect <3.
